Definition
[Reduced distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0128 1. ch19:19.43–19.45\group Reduced Geometry

For backward Ricci flow $g(\tau )$, define \[ \mathcal L(\gamma )=\int \sqrt\tau \, (R+|\dot\gamma |^2)\, d\tau , \quad L(x,\tau )=\inf _\gamma \mathcal L(\gamma ), \quad \ell (x,\tau )=\frac{L(x,\tau )}{2\sqrt\tau }. \]
